# Principal Component Analysis

PCA independent variables list

PRECINCT, STOP_FRISK_DATE, MEDIAN_AGE, MEDIAN_HOUSING_VALUE, LESS_THAN_HS_EDUCATION, BACHELORS_OR_ABOVE, UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE, PERCENT_HOUSEHOLDS_ON_SNAP, PERCENT_HOUSEHOLDS_IN_POVERTY, MEDIAN_HOUSEHOLD_INCOME, TOTAL_POPULATION, PERCENT_WHITE, PERCENT_BLACK, PERCENT_HISPANIC, POPULATION_CHANGE

```{r SQF descriptive statistics}

# summary statistics for stops
sqf_hist %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(YEAR2, SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION) %>%
  summarize(total = round(n(), 0),
            propArrested = round(sum(SUSPECT_ARRESTED_FLAG == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) / total, 3),
            propFrisked  = round(sum(FRISKED_FLAG == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) / total, 3),
            propSearched = round(sum(SEARCHED_FLAG == "Y", na.rm = TRUE) / total, 3)) %>%
  mutate(ALL = round(sum(total), 0)) %>%
  filter(SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION %in% BWH,
         YEAR2 >= 2021) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total, propArrested, propFrisked, propSearched),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = SUSPECT_RACE_DESCRIPTION,   # races become columns
    values_from = value                       # metric values fill the cells
  )
    
  # by year
    # BWH and ALL   
      # total number of stops
      # % arrested from stop
      # % frisked from stop
      # % searched from stop

```
